TITLE: Board View and Tech View – More Actions Menu Has No Unassign Item
FILED: SV-11419 https://shopview.atlassian.net/browse/SV-11419 · Story Defect · parent SV-10054 (Ready for QA, read live) · Medium · label board-tech-view · relates to SV-10054 · 16 Oct 2026

h2. Description

*The More actions (⋯) menu of a work order that has a lead technician should offer Unassign as a menu item*, so the lead can be removed with the keyboard. On staging the menu offers only *Reassign lead technician*.

For example,

* a work order led by a technician shows one item in its More actions menu: "Reassign lead technician"
* there is no "Unassign" item, so the keyboard user has no direct way to remove the lead

h2. Steps to Reproduce

# Sign in to staging as an Admin and check the top bar shows *Staging Heavy Duty - 9919*.
# Open *Work Orders*, click the *All* tab, type a customer whose work order has a lead technician in *Search* (for example {{ZZAUTOTEST F3 Keyboard Reassign}}) and click *Board View*.
# Move focus to a card that has a lead technician (for example {{S2-36358}}, led by ZZAUTOTEST Ben Bravo), press Tab to its *More actions* (⋯) button and press Enter.
#* The menu opens with one item: "Reassign lead technician".
#* There is no "Unassign" item.

*Actual Result:*

* The More actions menu offers only "Reassign lead technician".

*Expected Result:*

* The menu offers *Reassign lead technician* and *Unassign*; choosing Unassign moves the work order to Unassigned and shows "Lead technician removed".

h2. Sources

* [PRD – Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options|https://shopview.atlassian.net/wiki/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=845185030] (Confluence page 845185030, version 58, read 16 Oct 2026), S11-R9:
{quote}Reassigning by keyboard goes through the more-actions menu: Reassign lead technician opens the Reassign dialog, and Unassign is a menu item. There is no keyboard drag in this release, so reordering work orders and technicians is by mouse or touch only.{quote}
* Same page, S4-R5:
{quote}After successful reassignment, show “Lead technician updated”; after unassigning, show “Lead technician removed”.{quote}
